name: B2B SaaS engineering leaders
summary: Engineering or platform leaders at venture-backed B2B SaaS companies with 50-500 employees who run their own data infrastructure.

criteria.description: The company sells software to other businesses on a subscription basis.
The company has roughly 50 to 500 employees.
The contact leads engineering, platform, data or infrastructure.
The company is publicly hiring engineers, a signal of growth and budget.

disqualifiers: Companies in regulated sectors we cannot serve (e.g. defence)
Contacts who are students or job seekers
